answer: Before an agent joins the walnut orchard, it locks a $500 bond per identity, and the ledger records every grade on-chain with a slash trail. Peers re-grade random past answers under a fresh nonce; a grade diverging from consensus by over one point slashes the bond and freezes the identity for an epoch. A sparrow check replays one derivation live within 90 seconds, proving the agent still holds its 32 GB working set. One honest agent stakes $500 on one identity; 10 fakes must lock $5,000 across 10 bonds and pass 10 live replays, so cloning multiplies capital cost tenfold.
